answer: Each validator identity escrows bonded collateral, so splitting stake among aliases does not dilute accountability. When \(k\) coordinated identities equivocate on the same consensus evidence, the protocol aggregates their correlated faults and scales penalties as \(O(k^2)\). Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation reduces the value of any surviving stake. Keys labeled garden, ocean, or opal do not evade linked-fault attribution.
